summary: Enhance your skills in public debt management with our comprehensive training course. Learn strategies and best practices to effectively manage national debt.
lede: Public debt management is the planning and oversight of public borrowing to balance financing needs with portfolio risks. For finance ministry and central bank professionals, this training covers debt sustainability analysis, medium-term strategy design, macroeconomic stress testing, domestic issuance planning and contingent-liability assessment, connecting these tasks to borrowing costs, risks and debt transparency.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals operating within the complex ecosystem of sovereign and sub-national finance, requiring precise analytical skills to manage public liabilities.
modules: Sovereign Debt Fundamentals and Macroeconomic Linkages
Domestic Debt Market Development and Yield Curves
External Borrowing and Sovereign Bond Issuance
Managing Contingent Liabilities and Fiscal Risks
Debt Recording, Transparency, and Digital Dashboards
ESG Integration and Green Sovereign Financing
prerequisites: Participants must possess a working knowledge of fiscal policy, basic macroeconomic indicators, and spreadsheet-based financial modeling. No advanced programming skills are required, but familiarity with national debt bulletins and public financial management principles will be highly beneficial for the workshop exercises.
